## What is a listing?

A Quarto listing builds an organized collection of pages using their metadata. Instead of adding every project link manually, I can place a QMD file in `projects/` and give it a title, description, and categories. The listing updates when I render the website.

## How I set it up

```yaml
listing:
  id: portfolio
  contents: projects
  type: grid
  fields: [title, description, categories]
  categories: true
  filter-ui: true
  sort: title
```

A project page supplies the information used on its card:

```yaml
title: "Instagram dashboard prototype"
description: "A demonstration of content performance reporting."
categories: [Analytics, CEP]
```

## How this helps my portfolio

I could organize future work into analytics, content, and research categories. A hiring manager could quickly find a dashboard or read about a project’s purpose and limitations. I would add real results only after checking the data and confirming permission to share it.

[Quarto listings guide](https://quarto.org/docs/websites/website-listings.html)
